one_line: Bhil leader and ally of Maharana Pratap, guiding guerrilla resistance in the Aravalli hill forests.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean and wiry with the compact strength of a hill hunter.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown hill complexion tanned by sun, strong straight nose, sharp dark eyes with heavy brows, short neatly trimmed moustache and close beard along the jaw, a faint healed scar across the left eyebrow, default expression calm and watchful with a hint of defiant resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back in a low, compact knot at the nape, front kept smooth and practical; simple dark indigo cloth headwrap (pagadi-style strip) wrapped narrow around the forehead and tied at the back, with a small leaf tucked into one side as a subtle forest emblem.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 16th-century hill-war attire: a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton angarkha in muted earthy olive-green, overlapping and tied on the right side with two visible fabric ties; beneath it a natural off-white cotton tunic peeks at the neck and hem; a sturdy, plain, dark brown leather waist-belt with a simple iron buckle holds a small knife sheath; lower garment is a narrow, practical dhoti-like wrap in undyed beige cotton, pleated and drawn securely between the legs for easy movement, reaching just above the ankles; over one shoulder and across the chest is a faded brick-red cotton shawl (uttariya) used as a sling and for warmth, frayed slightly at the edges; feet in dark brown leather sandals with simple straps; minimal jewellery—one small iron bangle on the right wrist and a beaded black-and-brown thread necklace close to the neck, suggesting community identity rather than royal ornament; fabrics look homespun and slightly rough, with subtle vertical weave lines but no ornate embroidery.
appearance.signature: A tall, slightly recurved Bhil-style longbow made from dark polished wood, carried in his left hand with a taut natural-fiber string, and a cylindrical leather quiver on his back holding a dozen feather-fletched arrows with dark wood shafts and iron tips.

ref_desc: Rana Punja is a lean, medium-brown, sharp-eyed Bhil leader with a low-tied black hair knot and indigo headwrap, wearing an olive-green angarkha, beige dhoti, brick-red shoulder shawl, dark brown belt and sandals, and carrying a dark wooden Bhil longbow with a back quiver of arrows.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Rana Punja of Panarwa as a historically grounded late-16th-century Bhil leader from the Aravalli hills: a lean, wiry man in his late thirties with a medium-brown sun-tanned complexion, high cheekbones, sharp dark eyes under heavy brows, a short neat moustache and close beard along the jaw, and a faint scar across his left eyebrow, his default expression calm, watchful and quietly defiant. His thick black hair is tied back in a compact low knot at the nape, with a narrow indigo cloth headwrap wrapped around his forehead and tied at the back, a small leaf tucked into one side. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton angarkha in muted earthy olive-green that overlaps and ties on the right, with an off-white tunic just visible at the neck and hem, and a sturdy dark brown leather waist-belt with a simple iron buckle and small knife sheath. His lower garment is a practical beige cotton dhoti-like wrap, pleated and drawn between the legs to allow movement, reaching just above his ankles, and a faded brick-red cotton shawl runs from one shoulder across his chest like a sash, edges slightly frayed. Show his feet in dark brown leather sandals with simple straps, a single iron bangle on his right wrist, and a close black-and-brown beaded thread necklace; fabrics should look slightly rough and homespun with subtle vertical weave but no ornate decoration. His signature weapon is a tall, slightly recurved dark wooden Bhil longbow with a taut natural-fiber string held in his left hand, and a cylindrical dark leather quiver strapped on his back holding feather-fletched arrows with dark shafts and iron tips. Use a grounded palette of olive green, brick red, off-white, dark brown and touches of indigo, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show his face, hair, clothing details, and the bow and quiver.
